exercises.prompt: What is the underlying triliteral root of the Form VIII verb اِتَّقَى ('to be mindful/pious')?
exercises.explanation: Initial wāw assimilates into the infixed -t- of Form VIII, producing doubled تّ (اِتَّقَى from و-ق-ي).

feedback.rule: Form VIII initial wāw/yāʾ assimilates into infixed -t- → تّ.
feedback.commonError: Looking up اِتَّقَى under ت in an Arabic dictionary.

exercises.prompt: In Form VIII from root ص-ف-و, what does infixed ت become after the emphatic ص?
exercises.explanation: After emphatic consonants (ص ض ط ظ), Form VIII infixed -t- shifts to emphatic ط: اِصْطَفَى.

feedback.rule: Emphatic assimilation in Form VIII: ص + ت → صط.
